name: IST Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1976, IST Ltd manufactures high-precision engineering components/assemblies including auto components[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ISTL is in the business of manufacturing
 of high precision engineering components /assemblies for Automobile and Consumer Goods Industry. It also is a SEZ Developers 
 and does trading activities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.59 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.55% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.50% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.110 Cr.
